Same dissolution mechanism, two branches. Constructive: non-attachment, transcendence, mystical perception, imagination/ideal. Destructive: loss of distinction, idealization, illusion, confusion, victimhood, ego-defeat. No primitive rule strong Neptune = intuitive.

Nirvana is a school-specific spiritual register, not a universal Neptune. Non-attachment is not passivity; Hand lists destructive manifestations separately. Ego-denial/defeat is a bridge to psychological runtime, still school_specific.
